digest.component_or_area: rebar review CLI verb and llm.review_ticket library surface
propositions: rebar review CLI verb is superseded by rebar review-plan and must be retired via a loud deprecation shim that preserves read-only semantics (no sign=False passthrough).

The public library API rebar.llm.review_ticket must emit a DeprecationWarning via the registry but remain callable; internal callers (MCP tool, eval harness, diff harness) must call a private _review_ticket_impl to avoid double-signalling.
The shim must reject --graph and positional reviewer_id arguments with exit code 2 and a message naming review-plan, rather than accepting or silently discarding them.
The shim must fast-fail (exit 2, no LLM) on non-claimable tickets, diverging from the old verb which would invoke the model; this divergence is documented in help text and tested explicitly.

Three deprecation rows (cli, lib, mcp kinds) must be registered in src/rebar/_deprecations.py with _scheduled() and remove_in=v1.0.0, routed through warn_deprecated() rather than raw stderr/warnings emissions.
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["review"] must be repointed to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT and REVIEW_RESULT must be wired under a synthetic "review_ticket" key to prevent orphaning.
